notes.title: Steam Patch v1.5
notes.content:
A few changes due to feedback.  Changed how the menu works.  Added camera follow technique for players ship.  Boost is more functional.







The menu can now only be navigated with the mouse cursor as some people were finding it difficult to select other ships and few other problems with the way I had it setup.

The camera now slow follows the players ship so you can actually see the ship moving around as some people thought the ship was stationary.

Boost now works better and can be seen more with the new camera movement.

Also updated to Unity 2018.0.2.

notes.title: Mircron Wars XR Steam Patch 1
notes.content:
Hello my friends and fellow gamers.

I would like to announce that Mircron Wars XR will have a patch released this week addressing a few issues, but the main change is I have added steam Stats and Achievements.

I have a bit more testing to do with the Achievements first before I release the patch, it should be this week tho.

Game changes are that now the ships flash when getting damaged.

Controller support has been added, so your xbox or other controller should work with Mircron Wars XR now, you just might need to configure the buttons the way you like it.

Your ships now get collision damage when crashing into other ships, so look out for that lol.

And a few other small bug fixes.


I have plans in the future to add a leaderboard perhaps as well as maybe extending the game or making a dlc for it.  Another words I am not finished with this game yet lol.

Hope you all have a good Christmas this year and continue playing!
